trace.question: What is full name of the racer who ranked 1st in the 3rd qualifying race held in the Marina Bay Street Circuit in 2008?
trace.evidence: Ranked 1st in the 3rd qualifying race refer to MIN(q3); 2008 is the year of race; full name of racer = forename, surname

attempts.sql:
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS fullname
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND r.year = 2008
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
ORDER BY q.q3 ASC
LIMIT 1

trace.final_sql:
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS fullname
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND r.year = 2008
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
ORDER BY q.q3 ASC
LIMIT 1
trace.answer: Felipe Massa ranked 1st in the third qualifying race at the Marina Bay Street Circuit in 2008.
